intro: Explore opportunities, keep a shortlist and follow your applications.
emptyOpportunities: There are no opportunities to display right now. Come back soon.
emptySaved: You have no saved opportunities yet. Save one from the opportunity details.
emptyApplications: You have no applications yet. Open Matching to prepare a draft.
unavailableOpportunity: This opportunity is no longer available.
submitNotice: Review your cover letter before sending this application. The employer will receive your application and access your candidate profile/CV according to the platform policy.
applicationHelp: Prepare new drafts through Matching. Review and submit each draft explicitly here.
unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
forbidden: This account cannot access student pages.
notFound: This item was not found or is no longer available.
conflict: This record has changed. Refresh its status before continuing.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a little and try again.
uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Check the current status before trying again.
notConfigured: Web account connection settings are not configured yet.
profileHelp: Manage your profile, upload your CV and explore matching from your workspace.
bookmarkHelp: A saved opportunity is a bookmark, not a submitted application.
draftSaveHelp: Draft edits are saved when you submit the application.
